title: cadex race gc真空胎28C真不耐用
notes: Owner post (2025-07-13) on a 28 mm CADEX Race GC tubeless tire: sidewall cut early, worn to the casing at 4,000 km, sidewall crack, then a bulge 350 km later; cornering praised. Shop and generic comments are not counted. A commenter's mileage on a GP5000 clincher counts for that tire.
